#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

class HZSShufflesCards {
public:
    long long fact[200005], invFact[200005];
    int n, m;

    long long modpow(long long a, long long e) {
        long long res = 1;
        while (e) {
            if (e & 1) res = res * a % MOD;
            a = a * a % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    long long inv(long long a) {
        return modpow(a, MOD - 2);
    }

    long long ncr(int n, int r) {
        if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
        return fact[n] * invFact[r] % MOD * invFact[n - r] % MOD;
    }

    long long add(long long a, long long b) {
        long long v = a + b;
        return v < MOD ? v : v - MOD;
    }

    long long subtract(long long a, long long b) {
        long long v = a - b;
        return v < 0 ? v + MOD : v;
    }

    void solve() {
        cin >> n >> m;
        int N = n + m;

        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD;
        }

        invFact[N] = inv(fact[N]);
        for (int i = N; i >= 1; i--) {
            invFact[i - 1] = invFact[i] * i % MOD;
        }

        long long phaseSize = 1;
        for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
            long long num = ncr(n, k);
            long long den = ncr(N, k);
            long long p = num * inv(den) % MOD;
            phaseSize = add(phaseSize, p);
        }

        long long answer = 0;
        for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
            long long numPhases = (m + k) % MOD * inv(k) % MOD;
            long long e = numPhases * phaseSize % MOD;
            long long term = ncr(n, k) * e % MOD;

            if (k & 1) {
                answer = add(answer, term);
            } else {
                answer = subtract(answer, term);
            }
        }

        cout << answer << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    HZSShufflesCards solver;
    solver.solve();
    
    return 0;
}
